scope: Independent read-only diagnosis and guard review for a charged-coil/tooth coincidence. No production edits or subagents. Public-API reproducers compiled with ASAN+UBSAN; root implemented the guard concurrently.
verdict: Confirmed scheduler defect and exact reproduction. The reviewed bounded committed-edge guard fixes it without moving the discharge or relaxing existing dwell/timeout limits. Eight low-speed boundary cases and two8000RPM angular-bound cases behaved as intended. Full corrected external-plant validation remains root work.

diagnosis.correction_to_initial_hypothesis: The failed coil was C4/channel7, not C2. Saved rise1859412us and high_mask130 identify C4; crank tooth14 with phase offset60 is phase_tooth74/raw444degrees.

timeline.old_result: goal==angle makes reachablefalse while coilhigh; unreachable_deadline stops all outputs before old alarm

diagnosis.dwell_wording: The prior per-tooth acceleration correction had already changed actual dwell from2800us to2784us. The fix preserves that existing2784us discharge; it does not guarantee requested dwell equality or shorten it further.

before_fix_public_api_probe.evidence: Independently compiled temporary snapshot and exact public-API probe before the parent fix.

guard_assessment.eligibility: coil high, current target unreachable, committed pending future end, nonnegative committed duration and positive us_per_degree.
guard_assessment.ahead_rounding: target_offset_us<0.5 covers positive goals that round to now; larger positive goals use normal reachable scheduling rather than the exception.
guard_assessment.time_budget: Remaining old committed end must be at most25us.
guard_assessment.combined_angle_budget: late_deg=(remaining_us−target_offset_us)/us_per_degree must be within[0,0.2]. This bounds past-target angle plus remaining predicted travel together.
guard_assessment.dwell_budget: Committed end−start must remain at most the current configured max dwell.
guard_assessment.action: Restore the entire committed slot and continue, preserving exact low timestamp, latched advance, pulse metadata and cycle identity.
protections_unchanged: No new pulse is started or shortened by the guard.
No old end is moved later or earlier.
Stale control, phase watchdog, producer/capture age, IRQ lateness and high-time limits remain independently enforced.
Expired committed ends, larger time/angle errors and max-dwell violations still fault.
guard_assessment.why_separate_angle_bounds_were_insuffici: A goal0.19degrees behind plus0.19degrees future travel would have permitted0.38degrees total lateness under two independent0.2degree tests. The actual combined guard rejects that class.
guard_assessment.latency_limit: The0.2degree bound uses the software angle/speed estimate; it is not a claim of physical timing accuracy or measured target jitter.

independent_validation.accepted_edge_assertion: Every accepted case asserted the next popped event was channel7 low at exactly the old committed timestamp, with no new rise.
independent_validation.sanitizers: Both reproducer sets compiled and ran successfully with ASAN+UBSAN and -Wall -Wextra -Werror.

followups: Retain tooth-aligned advances0/6/12/18/24/30/36 and nearby fractional values as regression cases.
Keep batch/wasted coverage as well as Sequential because the guard applies to coils in both strategies.
Validate the corrected asymmetric plant through startup, acceleration/deceleration, rev cut, cam/crank faults and step convergence.
Keep actual dwell/energy and720degree spark error visible; do not relabel retained events as exact requested full dwell.
limits: Read-only independent code/diagnostic review with virtual timing only.
The full asymmetric engine model rerun and target/HIL timing remain separate.
Physical outputs remain inhibited; no vehicle, electrical, EMI/surge, thermal/splash/fit or live tuning qualification follows.
